properties.body:
GULF OF GUINEA.
NIGERIA.
1. SEISMIC SURVEY IN PROGRESS UNTIL 28 FEB 13
   BY M/V BGP PIONEER TOWING SIX 6500 METER
   LONG CABLES IN AREA BETWEEN
   03-44N 04-07N AND 007-02E 007-28E.
   FIVE MILE BERTH REQUESTED.
2. CANCEL HYDROLANT 2740/12.
3. CANCEL THIS MSG 01 MAR 13.
